verdict.rationale: AMD's MI355X product page documents expanded MXFP6 and MXFP4 datatype support. ROCm docs list vLLM and SGLang inference recipes on the ROCm platform. Independent benchmarks show real LLM serving (Kimi K3, TP8) on 8×MI355X passing accuracy checks, and Chips and Cheese covers its 8-bit and 16-bit matrix throughput. Missing for 10: first-party FP8 documentation specific to this part, MI355X-specific serving recipes (the vLLM/SGLang docs are generic ROCm), and any llama.cpp support evidence.
